name: v0.46.0
body:
## What's Changed
* [Partner Nodes] feat(LTX): add AlphaGen, SDR to HDR, Reframe and Upscale nodes by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17664
* [Partner Nodes] feat(MiniMax): add MiniMax H3 Image node by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17661
* Update workflow templates to v0.11.106 by @comfyui-wiki in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17668
* Fix for some workflows not working properly. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17675
* Conform Concatenate Video clips to the first clip's frame rate and audio (FRONT-3775) by @jtydhr88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17621
* [Partner Nodes] feat(Wan): move Wan nodes to Comfy Router by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17639
* [Partner Nodes] feat(Krea): move Krea nodes to Comfy Router by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17691
* [Partner Nodes] chore(ByteDance): drop the Seedance 2.5 4k enterprise-only wording by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17699
* Bump comfyui-frontend-package to 1.59.1 by @comfy-pr-bot in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17553
* Remove directml support. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17711
* [Partner Nodes] feat(Gemini-LLM): add Hydrogen/Argon and Carbon models by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17724
* Update workflow templates to v0.11.107 by @comfyui-wiki in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17725
* Support saving single channel PNG in the save image advanced node. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17727
* Add new node to split image channels by @alexisrolland in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/13548
* [Partner Nodes] feat(HeyGen): add 1080p, 30s clips and auto duration to HeyGen Video 1.0 nodes by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17721
* [Partner Nodes] fix(FishAudio): show Drama 3 full price in the badge by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17718
* [Partner Nodes] chore(OpenRouter): remove retired Qwen3.6 Max Preview model by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17737
* [Partner Nodes] feat(Luma): move Luma nodes to Comfy Router by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17714
* [Partner Nodes] feat(Anthropic): add Claude Fable 5.2 to the Claude node by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17738
* Fix some cases where apg affected output with cfg 1.0 by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17741
* Show Kling Avatar task IDs on polling timeout by @wei-hai in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17740
* Show Topaz request IDs on polling timeout by @wei-hai in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17742
* Add a mesh input to Create Camera Info to frame any mesh by @kijai in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17730
* Support embedded tokenizers for vocabulary-pruned Qwen checkpoints by @rattus128 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17633
* Video Deflicker node and Faster RAFT optical flow implementation by @kijai in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17754
* Don't hardcode video token id. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17759
* Add warning if someone is not using cuda 13 on a GPU that support it. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17760
* [Partner Nodes] feat(OpenRouter): add Meta Muse Wonder, Spark 1.3 and Ember models by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17744
* [Partner Nodes] feat(ByteDance): add Seedance 2.5 Flash to the Seedance 2.5 nodes by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17764
* Update workflow templates to v0.11.109 by @comfyui-wiki in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17765
* feat: Support PAN2 (CORE-719) by @kijai in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17755
* Make the cuda version warning yellow. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17769
* [Partner Nodes] feat(Bria): add RMBG 3.0 to the Remove Image Background node by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17780
* Fix dynamic VRAM buffer restore leaking a sampling schedule between models (CORE-716) by @chelsealong in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16491
* Update workflow templates to v0.11.110 by @comfyui-wiki in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17783
* Update embedded docs to v0.5.17 by @comfyui-wiki in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17761
* Update AGENTS.md with more specific instructions. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17789
* Support SenseNova thinking, interleaved generation, and self-correction (CORE-721) by @GACLove in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/16032
* Clean up previous PR. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17790
* [Partner Nodes] fix(Google-Omni): download the generated video when Google marks its file as failed by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17785
* Bump comfyui-frontend-package to 1.59.4 by @comfy-pr-bot in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17776
* [Partner Nodes] feat(HeyGen): add HeyGen Avatar 6 nodes by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17793
* [Partner Nodes] feat(Kling): add Kling 4.0 Image and Long Image nodes by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17797
* Update workflow templates to v0.11.111 by @comfyui-wiki in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17801
* Support Qwen3-1.7B in Generate Text by @synap5e in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17787
* Fix dynamo. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17808
* Add --force-output-rerun so output nodes write their files again on a cache hit by @christian-byrne in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17809
* Speed up sensenova text generation. by @comfyanonymous in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17811
* [Partner Nodes] feat: move more partner nodes to Comfy Router by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17794
* [Partner Nodes] chore: remove retired Claude Sonnet 4.5 model and leftover Moonvalley code by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17819
* [Partner Nodes] feat(Kling): add 4:3 and 3:4 aspect ratios to Kling 4.0 nodes by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17815
* [Partner Nodes] chore(FishAudio): switch speech-to-text to transcribe-1-pro by @bigcat88 in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17828
* Bump comfyui-frontend-package to 1.59.6 by @comfy-pr-bot in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17822

## New Contributors
* @wei-hai made their first contribution in https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/17740

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/compare/v0.45.0...v0.46.0
